name: Continuum Mechanics, Elasticity & Plasticity
summary: The rigorous tensor theory of deformable solids, covering elasticity, hyperelasticity, viscoelasticity and plasticity for advanced stress analysis and modelling.

topics.name: Kinematics of deformation: deformation gradient, finite and infinitesimal strain
Stress tensors (Cauchy, Piola-Kirchhoff) and balance laws
Linear elasticity: constitutive laws, anisotropy and boundary-value problems
Plane stress and plane strain; Airy stress-function solutions
Energy principles: minimum potential energy and Rayleigh-Ritz
Hyperelasticity for rubbers and soft materials (neo-Hookean, Mooney-Rivlin, Ogden)
Viscoelasticity: spring-dashpot models, creep, relaxation, time-temperature superposition
Plasticity: yield surfaces, flow rules, hardening and limit analysis
